metadata.case_name: CHAN CHAN PING v. COLLIERS JARDINE MANAGEMENT LTD

injuries.description: Crushed injury to left foot including open fracture of the proximal and distal phalanx and dislocation of the inter-phalangeal joint of the left big toe
source: As a result of the accident, the plaintiff suffered a crushed injury to his left foot.

Dr Tse's report refers to the results of physical examination and examination by X-ray which showed that the plaintiff had suffered open fracture of the proximal and distal phalanx as well as dislocation of the inter-phalangeal joint of the left big toe.
There was also an unsightly 4 cm scarred area over the first web of the foot covered by skin graft.
There was no movement of the metatarso-phalangeal joint or the inter-phalangeal joint of the big toe. These two joints were completely ankylosed in neutral position.
Dr Cheng commented that the plaintiff had probably suffered a crushed left big toe with open fracture and dislocation of the big toe.

manifestations.description: numbness of the left big toe
paresthesia of the left foot (residual and likely permanent)
occasional pain of the foot at night
could only walk for about 15 minutes and had to take a rest; could not stand for more than 20 to 30 minutes
could not stand on the left foot alone
stiffness of left toes and could not spread them; little motion of the toes
unsightly 4 cm scarred area over the first web of the foot covered by skin graft
diminished sensation of the big toe

treatments_received: two further wound debridements (24 and 27 June 1998)
out-patient follow up and daily wound dressing

losses.description: Unsightly 4 cm scarred area over the first web of the foot covered by skin graft
Walked with a slight limp, could only walk for about 15 minutes, could not stand for more than 20 to 30 minutes, could not stand on the left foot alone
Diminished sensation of the big toe and numbness of the left big toe
